title: Resigning from a job
about: Helps you resign from a job in New Zealand: how much notice to give, putting it in writing, your notice period, and what to expect in your final pay and holiday pay.
warning: General information from Employment New Zealand, not legal advice. Your employment agreement may have its own rules: check it.
audience: Employees in New Zealand who are thinking about resigning, or have resigned
version: Employment New Zealand pages "Resignation" (last modified 30 October 2026), "Notice periods" (last modified 30 October 2026) and "Final pay" (last modified 2 November 2026), read 18 Nov 2026

lines.text: You can resign at any time, even while you are on leave or annual holidays.
